_note: Voice for each speaker's impersonated clips (tools/generate_voice_clips.py). Keys are cast ids from cast.json (or a literal speaker label such as the landing's first mate). "ref": a reference recording of that person (6-30 s of clean speech) under art/voice_refs/ (gitignored: regenerate a missing one from "source" and "span"), with optional "extra_refs" (more clips of the same person, cut from "extra_spans") passed to XTTS together; "builtin": one of XTTS-v2's built-in studio voices, for characters who aren't real people. Speakers with neither are spoken with system text-to-speech.

atwood.from: 2004 Abramowitz Memorial Lecture at MIT, 'Oryx and Crake' Revisited (MIT Video Productions), Atwood lecturing alone; cut mono 22050 Hz, highpass 70 Hz, loudnorm I=-20
